# Epsilon-Closure & Epsilon-Removal (epsilon-NFA to NFA)

This notebook walks through the **epsilon-closure** computation and the
**epsilon-removal** algorithm that converts an epsilon-NFA into an equivalent NFA
without epsilon-transitions.  The running example is the concatenation automaton
for the language $\{ab\}$.

**epsilon-NFA states:**

- $q_0$ --- *initial* (non-accepting)
- $q_1$ --- reached from $q_0$ reading $a$
- $r_0$ --- reached from $q_1$ via the $\varepsilon$-edge
- $r_1$ --- *accepting*

**epsilon-NFA transitions:**
$\Delta(q_0,a)=\{q_1\}$, $\Delta(q_1,\varepsilon)=\{r_0\}$,
$\Delta(r_0,b)=\{r_1\}$.  All other transitions yield $\varnothing$.

This epsilon-NFA recognises exactly the language $\{ab\}$.

<script>
(function () {
  var STEPS = [
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 0 &mdash; Overview.</b> We will compute the &epsilon;-closure of each state: the set of states reachable via zero or more &epsilon;-transitions. Every state reaches at least itself (zero &epsilon;-steps).",
      active: [], ecl: [], edgeEps: false, rows: []
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 1 &mdash; ECl(q&#x2080;) = {q&#x2080;}.</b> Starting from q&#x2080;, there are no outgoing &epsilon;-edges. The only state reachable via &epsilon;-transitions is q&#x2080; itself (the trivial zero-step path).",
      active: ["q0"], ecl: [], edgeEps: false,
      rows: [{ state: "q₀", ecl: "{q₀}" }]
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 2 &mdash; ECl(q&#x2081;) = {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}.</b> From q&#x2081;, we can follow the &epsilon;-edge to reach r&#x2080;. Together with q&#x2081; itself (zero steps), the closure is {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}. The &epsilon;-edge is highlighted in red.",
      active: ["q1"], ecl: ["r0"], edgeEps: true,
      rows: [{ state: "q₀", ecl: "{q₀}" }, { state: "q₁", ecl: "{q₁, r₀}" }]
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 3 &mdash; ECl(r&#x2080;) = {r&#x2080;}.</b> From r&#x2080;, the only outgoing edge is labelled <code>b</code> (not &epsilon;). So the closure contains only r&#x2080; itself.",
      active: ["r0"], ecl: [], edgeEps: false,
      rows: [{ state: "q₀", ecl: "{q₀}" }, { state: "q₁", ecl: "{q₁, r₀}" }, { state: "r₀", ecl: "{r₀}" }]
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 4 &mdash; ECl(r&#x2081;) = {r&#x2081;}.</b> r&#x2081; has no outgoing edges at all. Its closure is just {r&#x2081;}. All &epsilon;-closures have been computed.",
      active: ["r1"], ecl: [], edgeEps: false,
      rows: [{ state: "q₀", ecl: "{q₀}" }, { state: "q₁", ecl: "{q₁, r₀}" }, { state: "r₀", ecl: "{r₀}" }, { state: "r₁", ecl: "{r₁}" }]
    }
  ];

  var idx = 0;
  var stepBtn    = document.getElementById("ec-w1-step");
  var resetBtn   = document.getElementById("ec-w1-reset");
  var progressEl = document.getElementById("ec-w1-progress");
  var explainEl  = document.getElementById("ec-w1-explain");
  var tableBody  = document.getElementById("ec-w1-table-body");

  var nodeEls = {
    q0: document.getElementById("ec-w1-q0"),
    q1: document.getElementById("ec-w1-q1"),
    r0: document.getElementById("ec-w1-r0"),
    r1: document.getElementById("ec-w1-r1")
  };
  var edgeEps = document.getElementById("ec-w1-edge-eps");

  function render() {
    var s = STEPS[idx];
    progressEl.textContent = "Step " + idx + " / " + (STEPS.length - 1);
    explainEl.innerHTML = s.explain;

    // highlight nodes
    ["q0","q1","r0","r1"].forEach(function(n) {
      var cls = "sc-nfa-node";
      if (s.active.indexOf(n) >= 0) cls += " active";
      else if (s.ecl.indexOf(n) >= 0) cls += " ecl-reach";
      nodeEls[n].className.baseVal = cls;
    });

    // highlight epsilon edge
    edgeEps.className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-edge" + (s.edgeEps ? " active" : "");
    edgeEps.setAttribute("marker-end", s.edgeEps ? "url(#ec-arrow-red)" : "url(#ec-arrow)");

    // render table
    tableBody.innerHTML = "";
    s.rows.forEach(function(row, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      var tdS = document.createElement("td"); tdS.textContent = row.state;
      var tdE = document.createElement("td"); tdE.textContent = row.ecl;
      if (i === s.rows.length - 1 && idx > 0) tdE.className = "highlight";
      tr.append(tdS, tdE);
      tableBody.appendChild(tr);
    });

    stepBtn.disabled  = idx >= STEPS.length - 1;
    resetBtn.disabled = idx === 0;
  }

  stepBtn.addEventListener("click",  function() { if (idx < STEPS.length - 1) { idx++; render(); } });
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { idx = 0; render(); });
  render();
})();
</script>
```

## Widget 2: Epsilon-Removal Algorithm

Click **Step &rarr;** to step through the construction of the new NFA
$\mathcal{A}' = (Q, \Sigma, \Delta', q_0, F')$ from the epsilon-closures above.

For each state $q$ and symbol $a$:
$$\Delta'(q, a) = \text{ECl}\!\bigl(\textstyle\bigcup_{p \in \text{ECl}(q)} \Delta(p, a)\bigr)$$

        <defs>
          <marker id="er-res-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <!-- initial arrow -->
        <line x1="30" y1="100" x2="72" y2="100" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#er-res-arrow)"/>
        <!-- q0 --a--> q1 (upper arc) -->
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 128 90 Q 175 40 222 90" marker-end="url(#er-res-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="163" y="55">a</text>
        <!-- q0 --a--> r0 (lower arc) -->

<script>
(function () {
  // Transition table rows build up progressively
  // Each step adds or updates one cell
  var STEPS = [
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 0 &mdash; Recall the &epsilon;-closures.</b> ECl(q&#x2080;) = {q&#x2080;}, ECl(q&#x2081;) = {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}, ECl(r&#x2080;) = {r&#x2080;}, ECl(r&#x2081;) = {r&#x2081;}. We now compute &Delta;'(q, a) = ECl(&cup;<sub>p&in;ECl(q)</sub> &Delta;(p, a)) for each state q and symbol a.",
      activeNodes: [], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:null,b:null},{from:"q₁",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₀",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: null, showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 1 &mdash; &Delta;'(q&#x2080;, a).</b> ECl(q&#x2080;) = {q&#x2080;}. Compute &Delta;(q&#x2080;, a) = {q&#x2081;}. Then ECl({q&#x2081;}) = {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}. So <code>&Delta;'(q&#x2080;, a) = {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["q0","q1","r0"], activeEdges: ["a","eps"],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:null},{from:"q₁",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₀",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: "q₀|a", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 2 &mdash; &Delta;'(q&#x2080;, b).</b> ECl(q&#x2080;) = {q&#x2080;}. Compute &Delta;(q&#x2080;, b) = &empty;. Then ECl(&empty;) = &empty;. So <code>&Delta;'(q&#x2080;, b) = &empty;</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["q0"], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₀",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: "q₀|b", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 3 &mdash; &Delta;'(q&#x2081;, a).</b> ECl(q&#x2081;) = {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}. Compute &Delta;(q&#x2081;, a) &cup; &Delta;(r&#x2080;, a) = &empty; &cup; &empty; = &empty;. Then ECl(&empty;) = &empty;. So <code>&Delta;'(q&#x2081;, a) = &empty;</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["q1","r0"], activeEdges: ["eps"],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:null},{from:"r₀",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: "q₁|a", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 4 &mdash; &Delta;'(q&#x2081;, b).</b> ECl(q&#x2081;) = {q&#x2081;, r&#x2080;}. Compute &Delta;(q&#x2081;, b) &cup; &Delta;(r&#x2080;, b) = &empty; &cup; {r&#x2081;} = {r&#x2081;}. Then ECl({r&#x2081;}) = {r&#x2081;}. So <code>&Delta;'(q&#x2081;, b) = {r&#x2081;}</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["q1","r0","r1"], activeEdges: ["eps","b"],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:null,b:null},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: "q₁|b", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 5 &mdash; &Delta;'(r&#x2080;, a).</b> ECl(r&#x2080;) = {r&#x2080;}. Compute &Delta;(r&#x2080;, a) = &empty;. Then ECl(&empty;) = &empty;. So <code>&Delta;'(r&#x2080;, a) = &empty;</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["r0"], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:"∅",b:null},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: "r₀|a", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 6 &mdash; &Delta;'(r&#x2080;, b).</b> ECl(r&#x2080;) = {r&#x2080;}. Compute &Delta;(r&#x2080;, b) = {r&#x2081;}. Then ECl({r&#x2081;}) = {r&#x2081;}. So <code>&Delta;'(r&#x2080;, b) = {r&#x2081;}</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["r0","r1"], activeEdges: ["b"],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₁",a:null,b:null}],
      hc: "r₀|b", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 7 &mdash; &Delta;'(r&#x2081;, a).</b> ECl(r&#x2081;) = {r&#x2081;}. Compute &Delta;(r&#x2081;, a) = &empty;. Then ECl(&empty;) = &empty;. So <code>&Delta;'(r&#x2081;, a) = &empty;</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["r1"], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₁",a:"∅",b:null}],
      hc: "r₁|a", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 8 &mdash; &Delta;'(r&#x2081;, b).</b> ECl(r&#x2081;) = {r&#x2081;}. Compute &Delta;(r&#x2081;, b) = &empty;. Then ECl(&empty;) = &empty;. So <code>&Delta;'(r&#x2081;, b) = &empty;</code>.",
      activeNodes: ["r1"], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₁",a:"∅",b:"∅"}],
      hc: "r₁|b", showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 9 &mdash; Determine F'.</b> Check whether ECl(q&#x2080;) &cap; F &ne; &empty;. We have ECl(q&#x2080;) = {q&#x2080;} and F = {r&#x2081;}. Since {q&#x2080;} &cap; {r&#x2081;} = &empty;, the initial state is not made accepting. Therefore <code>F' = F = {r&#x2081;}</code>.",
      activeNodes: [], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"★ r₁",a:"∅",b:"∅",final:true}],
      hc: null, showResult: false
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 10 &mdash; Construction complete! &#x2713;</b> The resulting NFA has the same four states, no &epsilon;-edges, and transitions: q&#x2080;&rarr;<sup>a</sup>&rarr;{q&#x2081;,r&#x2080;}, q&#x2081;&rarr;<sup>b</sup>&rarr;{r&#x2081;}, r&#x2080;&rarr;<sup>b</sup>&rarr;{r&#x2081;}. Accepting: {r&#x2081;}. It recognises the same language {ab}.",
      activeNodes: [], activeEdges: [],
      rows: [{from:"q₀",a:"{q₁, r₀}",b:"∅"},{from:"q₁",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"r₀",a:"∅",b:"{r₁}"},{from:"★ r₁",a:"∅",b:"∅",final:true}],
      hc: null, showResult: true
    }
  ];

  var idx = 0;
  var stepBtn    = document.getElementById("er-w2-step");
  var resetBtn   = document.getElementById("er-w2-reset");
  var progressEl = document.getElementById("er-w2-progress");
  var explainEl  = document.getElementById("er-w2-explain");
  var tableBody  = document.getElementById("er-w2-table-body");
  var resultDiv  = document.getElementById("er-w2-result");

  var nodeEls = {
    q0: document.getElementById("er-w2-q0"),
    q1: document.getElementById("er-w2-q1"),
    r0: document.getElementById("er-w2-r0"),
    r1: document.getElementById("er-w2-r1")
  };
  var edgeEls = {
    a:   document.getElementById("er-w2-edge-a"),
    eps: document.getElementById("er-w2-edge-eps"),
    b:   document.getElementById("er-w2-edge-b")
  };

  function renderTable(rows, hc) {
    tableBody.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (row.final) tr.className = "final-row";
      var tdS = document.createElement("td"); tdS.textContent = row.from;
      var tdA = document.createElement("td"); tdA.textContent = row.a || "—";
      if (hc === row.from + "|a") tdA.className = "highlight";
      var tdB = document.createElement("td"); tdB.textContent = row.b || "—";
      if (hc === row.from + "|b") tdB.className = "highlight";
      tr.append(tdS, tdA, tdB);
      tableBody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function render() {
    var s = STEPS[idx];
    progressEl.textContent = "Step " + idx + " / " + (STEPS.length - 1);
    explainEl.innerHTML = s.explain;

    // highlight nodes
    ["q0","q1","r0","r1"].forEach(function(n) {
      nodeEls[n].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (s.activeNodes.indexOf(n) >= 0 ? " active" : "");
    });

    // highlight edges
    ["a","eps","b"].forEach(function(e) {
      var active = s.activeEdges.indexOf(e) >= 0;
      edgeEls[e].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-edge" + (active ? " active" : "");
      edgeEls[e].setAttribute("marker-end", active ? "url(#er-arrow-red)" : "url(#er-arrow)");
    });

    renderTable(s.rows, s.hc);
    resultDiv.style.display = s.showResult ? "block" : "none";
    stepBtn.disabled  = idx >= STEPS.length - 1;
    resetBtn.disabled = idx === 0;
  }

  stepBtn.addEventListener("click",  function() { if (idx < STEPS.length - 1) { idx++; render(); } });
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { idx = 0; render(); });
  render();
})();
</script>
```

---

## Widget 3: Word Simulation on Both Automata

Type a word over $\{a,b\}$ (default `ab`) and step through it on **both** the
original $\varepsilon$-NFA and the resulting NFA side by side, confirming they
accept the same words.

```{=html}
<!-- WIDGET 3 — dual simulation -->
<div class="sc-lab" id="er-w3-lab">
  <div class="sc-field">
    <label for="er-w3-input">Input word over {a,b}</label>
    <input id="er-w3-input" value="ab" spellcheck="false" inputmode="text">
  </div>
  <div class="sc-btn-row">
    <button class="sc-btn" id="er-w3-step">Step &#x2192;</button>
    <button class="sc-btn alt" id="er-w3-reset">Reset</button>
    <span class="sc-progress" id="er-w3-progress"></span>
  </div>
  <div class="sc-explain" id="er-w3-explain"></div>
  <div class="sc-symbol-track" id="er-w3-track"></div>

  <div class="sc-two-graphs">
    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">
      <h4>&#x3B5;-NFA &mdash; active states</h4>
      <svg style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;" viewBox="0 0 660 120" role="img" aria-label="epsilon-NFA simulation">
        <defs>
          <marker id="er-w3-enfa-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <line x1="30" y1="60" x2="72" y2="60" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#er-w3-enfa-arrow)"/>
        <line class="sc-nfa-edge" x1="128" y1="60" x2="222" y2="60" marker-end="url(#er-w3-enfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="172" y="52">a</text>
        <line class="sc-nfa-edge" x1="278" y1="60" x2="372" y2="60" marker-end="url(#er-w3-enfa-arrow)" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="318" y="52">&#x3B5;</text>
        <line class="sc-nfa-edge" x1="428" y1="60" x2="522" y2="60" marker-end="url(#er-w3-enfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="472" y="52">b</text>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-enfa-q0" transform="translate(100,60)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">q&#x2080;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-enfa-q1" transform="translate(250,60)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">q&#x2081;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-enfa-r0" transform="translate(400,60)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">r&#x2080;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-enfa-r1" transform="translate(550,60)">
          <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#30bced" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">r&#x2081;</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>

    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">
      <h4>NFA (&#x3B5;-free) &mdash; active states</h4>
      <svg style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;" viewBox="0 0 660 200" role="img" aria-label="NFA epsilon-free simulation">
        <defs>
          <marker id="er-w3-nfa-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <line x1="30" y1="100" x2="72" y2="100" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#er-w3-nfa-arrow)"/>
        <!-- q0 --a--> q1 (upper) -->
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 128 90 Q 175 40 222 90" marker-end="url(#er-w3-nfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="163" y="55">a</text>
        <!-- q0 --a--> r0 (lower) -->
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 128 110 Q 250 180 372 110" marker-end="url(#er-w3-nfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="240" y="172">a</text>
        <!-- q1 --b--> r1 -->
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 278 90 Q 400 30 522 90" marker-end="url(#er-w3-nfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="395" y="40">b</text>
        <!-- r0 --b--> r1 -->
        <line class="sc-nfa-edge" x1="428" y1="100" x2="522" y2="100" marker-end="url(#er-w3-nfa-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="472" y="92">b</text>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-nfa-q0" transform="translate(100,100)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">q&#x2080;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-nfa-q1" transform="translate(250,100)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">q&#x2081;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-nfa-r0" transform="translate(400,100)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">r&#x2080;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="er-w3-nfa-r1" transform="translate(550,100)">
          <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#30bced" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">r&#x2081;</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-panel" style="margin-top:0;">
    <h4>Simulation trace</h4>
    <table class="sc-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Prefix</th><th>&#x3B5;-NFA active</th><th>NFA active</th><th>Accepted?</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="er-w3-trace"></tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="margin-top:10px;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--sc-label);" id="er-w3-invariant"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // epsilon-NFA transitions: after reading a symbol, we also close under epsilon
  // delta(q0,a)={q1}, delta(q1,eps)={r0}, delta(r0,b)={r1}
  // epsilon-closure: ecl(q0)={q0}, ecl(q1)={q1,r0}, ecl(r0)={r0}, ecl(r1)={r1}

  function ecl(states) {
    var result = {};
    states.forEach(function(s) {
      result[s] = true;
      if (s === "q1") result["r0"] = true;
    });
    return Object.keys(result).sort();
  }

  // epsilon-NFA step: read symbol, then close under epsilon
  function enfaStep(states, sym) {
    // first, epsilon-close the current states
    var closed = ecl(states);
    // then, apply symbol transitions from the closed set
    var next = {};
    closed.forEach(function(s) {
      if (s === "q0" && sym === "a") next["q1"] = true;
      if (s === "r0" && sym === "b") next["r1"] = true;
    });
    // epsilon-close the result
    return ecl(Object.keys(next));
  }

  // NFA (epsilon-free) transitions from Delta'
  // Delta'(q0,a)={q1,r0}, Delta'(q1,b)={r1}, Delta'(r0,b)={r1}
  function nfaStep(states, sym) {
    var next = {};
    states.forEach(function(s) {
      if (s === "q0" && sym === "a") { next["q1"] = true; next["r0"] = true; }
      if (s === "q1" && sym === "b") { next["r1"] = true; }
      if (s === "r0" && sym === "b") { next["r1"] = true; }
    });
    return Object.keys(next).sort();
  }

  function fmtStates(states) {
    if (!states.length) return "∅";
    return "{" + states.map(function(s) {
      if (s === "q0") return "q₀";
      if (s === "q1") return "q₁";
      if (s === "r0") return "r₀";
      if (s === "r1") return "r₁";
      return s;
    }).join(", ") + "}";
  }

  function hasAccepting(states) { return states.indexOf("r1") >= 0; }

  function sanitize(v) { return v.toLowerCase().replace(/[^ab]/g, ""); }

  var inputEl    = document.getElementById("er-w3-input");
  var stepBtn    = document.getElementById("er-w3-step");
  var resetBtn   = document.getElementById("er-w3-reset");
  var progressEl = document.getElementById("er-w3-progress");
  var explainEl  = document.getElementById("er-w3-explain");
  var trackEl    = document.getElementById("er-w3-track");
  var traceEl    = document.getElementById("er-w3-trace");
  var invEl      = document.getElementById("er-w3-invariant");

  // enfa graph nodes
  var enfaNodes = {
    q0: document.getElementById("er-w3-enfa-q0"),
    q1: document.getElementById("er-w3-enfa-q1"),
    r0: document.getElementById("er-w3-enfa-r0"),
    r1: document.getElementById("er-w3-enfa-r1")
  };
  // nfa graph nodes
  var nfaNodes = {
    q0: document.getElementById("er-w3-nfa-q0"),
    q1: document.getElementById("er-w3-nfa-q1"),
    r0: document.getElementById("er-w3-nfa-r0"),
    r1: document.getElementById("er-w3-nfa-r1")
  };

  var symIdx, enfaActive, nfaActive, rows;

  function renderTrack(word) {
    trackEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (!word.length) {
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "sc-sym"; sp.textContent = "ε";
      trackEl.appendChild(sp); return;
    }
    word.split("").forEach(function(c, i) {
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "sc-sym" + (i === symIdx ? " current" : "");
      sp.textContent = c; trackEl.appendChild(sp);
    });
  }

  function renderTrace() {
    traceEl.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(r, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (i === rows.length - 1) tr.style.fontWeight = "bold";
      [r.prefix, r.enfa, r.nfa, r.accepted ? "✅ Yes" : "❌ No"].forEach(function(v) {
        var td = document.createElement("td"); td.textContent = v; tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      traceEl.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function applyGraphNodes(nodeMap, active) {
    ["q0","q1","r0","r1"].forEach(function(n) {
      nodeMap[n].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (active.indexOf(n) >= 0 ? " active" : "");
    });
  }

  function reset() {
    var word = sanitize(inputEl.value);
    if (word !== inputEl.value) inputEl.value = word;
    symIdx = 0;
    enfaActive = ["q0"];
    nfaActive  = ["q0"];
    rows = [{ prefix: "ε", enfa: fmtStates(enfaActive), nfa: fmtStates(nfaActive), accepted: false }];
    explainEl.innerHTML = "<b>Initialised.</b> Both automata start in state {q₀}. Since q₀ has no outgoing ε-edges, the ε-closure of the initial set is still {q₀}.";
    invEl.textContent = "Both automata agree: active states = {q₀}, not accepting.";
    progressEl.textContent = "Symbol 0 / " + word.length;
    renderTrack(word); renderTrace();
    applyGraphNodes(enfaNodes, enfaActive);
    applyGraphNodes(nfaNodes, nfaActive);
    stepBtn.disabled = word.length === 0;
  }

  function step() {
    var word = sanitize(inputEl.value);
    if (symIdx >= word.length) return;
    var sym = word[symIdx];
    var prevEnfa = enfaActive;
    var prevNfa  = nfaActive;
    enfaActive = enfaStep(prevEnfa, sym);
    nfaActive  = nfaStep(prevNfa, sym);
    symIdx++;

    var accepted = hasAccepting(enfaActive);
    var prefix = word.slice(0, symIdx);
    rows.push({
      prefix: prefix,
      enfa: fmtStates(enfaActive),
      nfa: fmtStates(nfaActive),
      accepted: accepted
    });

    explainEl.innerHTML =
      "<b>Read ‘" + sym + "’.</b> " +
      "ε-NFA: from " + fmtStates(prevEnfa) + " reading <code>" + sym + "</code> gives " + fmtStates(enfaActive) + ". " +
      "NFA: from " + fmtStates(prevNfa) + " reading <code>" + sym + "</code> gives " + fmtStates(nfaActive) + ". " +
      (accepted ? "<b>Prefix accepted ✅</b>" : "Prefix not accepted ❌");

    var agree = fmtStates(enfaActive) === fmtStates(nfaActive);
    invEl.textContent = agree
      ? "Both automata agree: active states = " + fmtStates(enfaActive) + (accepted ? " (accepting)" : " (not accepting)")
      : "ε-NFA: " + fmtStates(enfaActive) + ", NFA: " + fmtStates(nfaActive);

    progressEl.textContent = "Symbol " + symIdx + " / " + word.length;
    renderTrack(word); renderTrace();
    applyGraphNodes(enfaNodes, enfaActive);
    applyGraphNodes(nfaNodes, nfaActive);
    stepBtn.disabled = symIdx >= word.length;

    if (symIdx >= word.length) {
      explainEl.innerHTML +=
        "<br><b>Word fully consumed.</b> " +
        (accepted ? "Active states contain r₁ → <b>ACCEPTED ✅</b>" : "No accepting state is active → <b>REJECTED ❌</b>") +
        " &mdash; both automata agree.";
    }
  }

  inputEl.addEventListener("input", reset);
  stepBtn.addEventListener("click", step);
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", reset);
  reset();
})();
</script>
```

---

## What To Notice

1. **The $\varepsilon$-closure absorbs free moves into transition targets.**
   Instead of taking an $a$-step and then following $\varepsilon$-edges, the
   $\varepsilon$-removal construction folds those free moves directly into the
   transition function: $\Delta'(q_0, a) = \{q_1, r_0\}$ already includes
   $r_0$, which was originally reachable only via $q_1 \xrightarrow{\varepsilon} r_0$.

2. **The resulting NFA has no $\varepsilon$-edges but accepts the same language.**
   Both Widget 3 traces show identical accept/reject verdicts for every word.
   The language $\{ab\}$ is preserved exactly.

3. **States $q_1$ and $r_0$ become equivalent in the resulting NFA.**
   After $\varepsilon$-removal, both $q_1$ and $r_0$ have the same outgoing
   transitions: nothing on $a$, and $\{r_1\}$ on $b$.  They are
   indistinguishable and could be merged by a subsequent minimisation step.

4. **The accepting set $F'$ can grow.**
   In this example $\text{ECl}(q_0) \cap F = \varnothing$, so $F' = F$.  But if the initial
   state could reach an accepting state via $\varepsilon$-edges, we would need to
   add the initial state to $F'$, making the empty word $\varepsilon$ accepted.
